description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for GET api/SearchProduct/getMissingListings. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Returns marketplace/channel listings that HGR detected during the latest periodic synchronization as missing from HGR for the current store. ownerAgent: listings. Domain: listings. Entity: missing_listing. Operation: list_missing. Scope: current_store. Use when: Use it when the user asks what products or listings from the current store can be imported into HGR, what listings are missing in HGR, or what items were detected as not present after synchronization. Input: Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. No body. Output: Returns missing listing candidates with ChannelItem, ChannelTitle, Sku and variation attributes. HGRApi removes entries that already exist in HGR as successfully created listings before returning them. Search terms: searchproduct getmissinglistings. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

name: hgr_get_searchproduct_getmissinglistings
title: Get Searchproduct Getmissinglistings
